f.title: Submit all safety notifications to ANMAT through the eReporting Industria platform
f.statement: ANMAT establishes the "eReporting Industria" platform as the single system for marketing authorisation holders of medicinal products to send to the Pharmacovigilance and Risk Management Department (central unit of the National Pharmacovigilance System) notifications of suspected adverse reactions, events supposedly attributable to vaccination and immunisation (ESAVI) and other safety problems related to the use of medicines, such as medication errors, lack of effectiveness and exposure in pregnancy.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised in Argentina. Compliance required within 180 calendar days of entry into force (Art 3). Disposition in force from its publication in the Boletín Oficial on 05-04-2024 (Art 7). Original language Spanish.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular de Autorización de Registro y Comercialización)
rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 1º- Establécese la implementación de la plataforma “eReporting Industria” como sistema único para el envío por parte de las empresas Titulares de Autorización de Registro y Comercialización de Especialidades medicinales al Departamento de Farmacovigilancia y Gestión de Riesgo, Efector central del Sistema Nacional de Farmacovigilancia, de las notificaciones relativas a sospechas de Reacciones adversas, Eventos Supuestamente Atribuibles a la Vacunación e Inmunización y otros problemas de seguridad relacionados con el uso de medicamentos tales como errores de medicación, falta de efectividad y exposición en embarazo.
rows.review_note: Review: removed VigiFlow from systems (named only in the recitals, not in Art 1); added Art 3 compliance period and Art 7 entry into force to applicability. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Confirmed: "Establécese ... como sistema único" for submissions by TARCs; enacting verb read as Mandatory, actor named in the quote. Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 1 - The implementation of the "eReporting Industria" platform is hereby established as the single system for the sending, by the companies holding Registration and Marketing Authorisation of medicinal products, to the Pharmacovigilance and Risk Management Department, Central Unit of the National Pharmacovigilance System, of notifications relating to suspected Adverse Reactions, Events Supposedly Attributable to Vaccination and Immunisation and other safety problems related to the use of medicines such as medication errors, lack of effectiveness and exposure in pregnancy.

f.title: Implement MedDRA and WHODrug coding and obtain the licences
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders of medicinal products must implement the MedDRA and WHODrug coding systems, obtaining the corresponding licences from the competent organisations.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised in Argentina. Compliance required within 180 calendar days of entry into force (Art 3). Disposition in force from its publication in the Boletín Oficial on 05-04-2024 (Art 7). Original language Spanish.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular de Autorización de Registro y Comercialización)
rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 2º- Las empresas Titulares de Autorización de Registro y Comercialización de Especialidades medicinales deberán implementar los sistemas de codificación MedDRA y WHODrug, tramitando las licencias correspondientes ante los organismos competentes.
rows.review_note: Review: added Art 3 compliance period and Art 7 entry into force to applicability. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Confirmed: explicit "deberán" and actor. Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 2 - Companies holding Registration and Marketing Authorisation of medicinal products shall implement the MedDRA and WHODrug coding systems, obtaining the corresponding licences from the competent organisations.

f.title: Comply with eReporting Industria and MedDRA/WHODrug requirements within 180 calendar days
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders must comply with Articles 1 (use of eReporting Industria) and 2 (MedDRA and WHODrug implementation) within no more than 180 calendar days from the entry into force of the Disposition.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised in Argentina. Disposition in force from its publication in the Boletín Oficial on 05-04-2024 (Art 7). Original language Spanish.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular de Autorización de Registro y Comercialización)
rows.deadline: No more than 180 calendar days from the entry into force of the Disposition
rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 3°- Las empresas Titulares de Autorización de Registro y Comercialización de Especialidades medicinales deberán dar cumplimiento a lo establecido en los artículos 1° y 2°, en un plazo no mayor de 180 (CIENTO OCHENTA) días corridos a partir de la entrada en vigencia de la presente disposición.
rows.review_note: Review: clock start clarified in applicability (entry into force on publication, 05-04-2024, Art 7). Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Confirmed: explicit "deberán", actor and 180-day period. Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 3 - Companies holding Registration and Marketing Authorisation of medicinal products shall comply with the provisions of Articles 1 and 2 within a period of no more than 180 (ONE HUNDRED AND EIGHTY) calendar days from the entry into force of this disposition.

deadline_rule.clock_start: la entrada en vigencia de la presente disposición
deadline_rule.applies_to: One-time implementation of Articles 1 and 2 (notification via eReporting Industria) by MAHs

f.title: Request eReporting Industria user accounts at least 45 calendar days before first submission
f.statement: Marketing authorisation holders must apply to the Pharmacovigilance and Risk Management Department for the creation of users at least 45 calendar days before starting to send notifications through the eReporting Industria tool.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular de Autorización de Registro y Comercialización)
rows.deadline: At least 45 calendar days before starting to send notifications via eReporting Industria
rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 4°- Las empresas Titulares de Autorización de Registro y Comercialización de Especialidades medicinales deberán tramitar la generación de los usuarios ante el Departamento de Farmacovigilancia y Gestión de Riesgo con una antelación mínima de 45 (CUARENTA Y CINCO) días corridos previo al inicio del envío de las notificaciones mediante la herramienta “eReporting Industria”.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Confirmed: explicit "deberán", actor and 45-day lead time. Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 4 - Companies holding Registration and Marketing Authorisation of medicinal products shall apply to the Pharmacovigilance and Risk Management Department for the creation of users at least 45 (FORTY-FIVE) calendar days before starting to send notifications through the "eReporting Industria" tool.

f.title: Follow the eReporting Industria user manual when submitting notifications
f.statement: The procedure for sending notifications through the eReporting Industria tool must be carried out according to the instructions in the "Manual de Uso eReporting Industria", to be published on the ANMAT website.
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised in Argentina. Original language Spanish.
f.systems: eReporting Industria; Manual de Uso eReporting Industria

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular de Autorización de Registro y Comercialización)
rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 5°- El procedimiento para el envío de notificaciones mediante la herramienta “eReporting Industria” deberá realizarse de acuerdo con las instrucciones establecidas en el “Manual de Uso eReporting Industria”, el que será publicado en la página web institucional.
rows.review_note: Review: no change; passive "deberá realizarse" assigned to the MAH as the submitter. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Below 90: passive "deberá realizarse"; MAH actor inferred. Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 5 - The procedure for sending notifications through the "eReporting Industria" tool shall be carried out in accordance with the instructions set out in the "eReporting Industria User Manual", which will be published on the institutional website.

f.title: Other reporting routes remain available only to patients, HCPs and peripheral units, not to MAHs
f.statement: Notwithstanding the start of operation of the eReporting modules for patients, healthcare professionals and peripheral units, the other reporting routes currently in use remain available only for these reporters (patients, healthcare professionals and peripheral units).
f.applicability: Medicinal products (especialidades medicinales) authorised in Argentina. Original language Spanish.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Titular de Autorización de Registro y Comercialización)
rows.quote: ARTÍCULO 6°- Sin perjuicio de la puesta en funcionamiento de los módulos de “eReporting” para pacientes, profesionales sanitarios y efectores periféricos, establécese que continúan disponibles únicamente para estos notificadores las otras vías de reportes utilizadas en la actualidad.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Level Mandatory reflects the restriction on MAHs (other routes remain only for patients, HCPs and peripheral units, read with Art 1 "sistema único"); title wording "not to MAHs" is that inference. Translation check: agrees. Double-check: Below 90: article restricts other routes to patients, HCPs and peripheral units; the MAH actor and the "not to MAHs" reading are inferred from Art 1 "sistema único", not stated. Translation verified (quote_en re-read against the Spanish; reviewer re-translation agrees).
rows.quote_en: ARTICLE 6 - Notwithstanding the start of operation of the "eReporting" modules for patients, healthcare professionals and peripheral units, it is hereby established that the other reporting routes currently in use remain available only for these reporters.

dates.title: ANMAT Disposición 3031/2024 (eReporting Industria): enters into force
dates.scope: Holders of registration and marketing authorisation of medicinal products (especialidades medicinales), Argentina

dates.quote_en: ARTICLE 7.- This disposition shall enter into force on the day of its publication in the Official Gazette (Boletín Oficial).

dates.scope: Holders of registration and marketing authorisation of medicinal products; obligations of Articles 1 and 2 (notification via eReporting Industria)
dates.quote: ARTÍCULO 3°- Las empresas Titulares de Autorización de Registro y Comercialización de Especialidades medicinales deberán dar cumplimiento a lo establecido en los artículos 1° y 2°, en un plazo no mayor de 180 (CIENTO OCHENTA) días corridos a partir de la entrada en vigencia de la presente disposición.
dates.quote_en: ARTICLE 3.- Companies holding registration and marketing authorisation of medicinal products shall comply with Articles 1 and 2 within a period of no more than 180 (ONE HUNDRED AND EIGHTY) calendar days from the entry into force of this disposition.
